title: Compile-Time Checked UI Labels Across Locale, Terminology and Brand
description: Make wrong-language/wrong-terminology/wrong-brand UI labels impossible to ship: generate Locale/Terminology as cross-language enums (JSON -> Rust + TS, mirroring the icon/entity-kinds codegen precedent), extend app_labels! to an exhaustive two-axis (locale x terminology) macro, introduce a Label/LabelText/LocalizedLabel type family in ui_wgpu that replaces every raw String label on the UiNode wire and the app manifest, delete the stringly-typed AppLabelsOverlay runtime patch entirely, brand a UiLabel type on the TS/React side so component text props reject plain string literals, fix first-paint locale resolution (currently async, causing an English flash and the demonstrator's English "Close"/"Back" chrome under German-locked brands), lock reuse terminology on all six mit-bestand brands, and replace the dead/vacuous chrome-i18n scan gate with a structural one wired into the root verify gate. Full design in the approved plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/there-are-still-plenty-sprightly-journal.md.
summary:
Completed the "Wave 1c" ui-kit UiLabel prop-retyping slice (items 1-3 of the assignment) plus its required downstream fallout fixes in both the ui-react package and the OS renderer engine package.

ui-react (🧰️framework/🔨️module/🖱️ui/⚛️react/⚡️implementation/🟦️typescript/📦️index.tsx):
- Retyped 38 component prop declarations from string/string|undefined to UiLabel/UiLabel|undefined across CanvasPickMenuProps, IconProps, ContextMenuItem, PanelTreeUnit, Dialog title, DescriptionTooltipData, AsideProps, DraggableAvatarProps, ErrorViewProps, SectionProps, ActionDropdownOption, ComboboxProps, inline-edit props, ToggleGroup placeholder, NavbarExampleSelectProps, TreeSectionAction/TreeCheckboxAction/TreeCheckboxProps/TreeFilesProps, WindowMeasureTreeLeafProps, pane-toggle label, Engagement*Control variants, SearchInput, WindowLayoutWindowNode, PageFrontmatter, Table/VirtualFileSystem emptyMessage, FileNodeDescriptor, ModeWindowDescriptor, AppModeDescriptor, UiAppDescriptor. Deliberately skipped non-UI-facing fields called out in the task (manual/tutorial doc-link fields, the childProps aria-label type-cast, and wire-boundary fields like DialogDefinition.submitLabel/IntroductionLogo.alt that stay string by design).
- Made ContextMenu/ContextMenuController `title` required (removed the "Menu" defaults) and fixed every internal call site: Card/DiagramNode/TreeItemRowContextMenu/TextSelectionContextMenuHost now resolve a real translation (reusing/adding `ui.common.actions`), and the ~170 inline-test call sites were fixed with real judgment (uiDataLabel for genuine test-fixture literals, never blanket-wrapped).
- Fixed cascading fallout: TextSelectionContextMenuLabels retyped to UiLabel (dead `?? "Cut"` literal fallbacks removed since the translation keys already existed); Input/Textarea computedPlaceholder logic reworked to produce UiLabel via useIdLabel/uiDataLabel; menuTreeHeaderActionsToContextItems label resolution fixed; VIRTUAL_FILE_SYSTEM_DEMO_FILE_NODE_KINDS descriptors wrapped in uiDataLabel (already chrome-i18n-allow marked).
- Icon-selector mode SelectItems (URL/Shortcode/Math/Data URL/Emoji/Text/Catalog SVG) moved into new `ui.iconSelector.mode.*` schema keys (EN+DE) and wired via useLabel.
- Added new schema sections with EN+DE translations: `ui.flowSpotlight.*`, `ui.sync.*`, `ui.ink.*`, `ui.surfaceContextMenu.*` (16 distinct surface-specific context-menu titles).

OS renderer engine (🧰️framework/🛍️product/💻️os/🔨️module/📺️renderer/🧑️‍🎨️engine/⚛️react/⚡️implementation/🟦️typescript/📦️index.tsx + 🧪️index.test.ts):
- Added the sanctioned `wireLabel` wire-boundary mint function in the UiInterpreter region and used it at every genuine manifest/plugin-resolved-string boundary (mapContextMenuSpecs, VirtualFileSystem.emptyMessage, Section title in interpretUiNode, convertFrameworkLayoutNodeToModeLayout, retitleWindowLayoutNode, spawned-app document title).
- Fixed all 18 ContextMenuController/ContextMenu call sites needing a title (task estimated ~9; actual count was 18) with distinct, surface-specific translated titles: File/Workspace/Canvas/Scene/Placement suggestions/Node (x2)/Flow/Editor/Row/Paint/Map/Board/Ink/History/Step/Diff/Event actions.
- Fixed the explicitly-listed hardcoded strings: "Checking placement…"/"No placement" (existing `ui.host.*` keys), "Type to add…"/"Collapse suggestions"/"Show all suggestions" (new `ui.flowSpotlight.*` keys), "No matches" (reused `ui.windowSearch.noMatches`), "Attach"/"Detach" (new `ui.sync.*` keys), "Link"/`window.prompt("Link URL")` (new `ui.ink.*` keys).
- Fixed the UI-driver "Default"/"Compact" root cause: new `driverDisplayLabel()` helper resolves `settings.driver.default`/`settings.driver.compact` for builtin drivers, falls back to the driver's own `.label` (genuine data) for custom drivers — used at both real render sites (command-palette arg options, settings driver Select).
- Changed `shellLabel`/`interpLabel` (non-hook translation resolvers) return type from `string` to `UiLabel` — a safe widening change (UiLabel is a branded string subtype) that fixed a wide swath of CommandDialog title/description call sites in one shot.
- Extended the existing test file (no new test files): `suggestionMenuItems` signature now takes a `labels` param (its one existing call site updated with uiDataLabel fixtures); two `retitleWindowLayoutNode` test fixtures wrapped in uiDataLabel.

Adjacent fix (directly broken by the ContextMenu title requirement, not explicitly in scope but left working): .storybook/stories/ui/ContextMenu.stories.tsx — wrapped all 33 ContextMenuItem.label literals and both ContextMenuController/meta title sites in uiDataLabel.

Verification:
- ui-react: `bun ./📜️script.ts typecheck` clean except 27 pre-existing/unrelated baseline errors (xyflow Node type collisions, icon-type mismatches, implicit-any params, instanceof, readonly-prop assignment, missing iconId on unrelated test fixtures) — confirmed unrelated by diffing before/after error sets. `check-chrome-i18n` reports 0 violations. `test quick`: 496/505 passed; the 9 failures are pre-existing/unrelated (THREE.js camera duck-typing, icon-hover CSS rule lookup, jsdom Event.target.closest/Node.contains gaps, a CSS calc()/min() difference) — none touch labels, ContextMenu, or translations.
- OS renderer engine: this package has no scoped typecheck target or local tsconfig.json (confirmed via project.json/script.ts — only test/lint targets exist), so verification used the repo-root `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`, filtered to this file, with a before/after diff. Every UiLabel/ContextMenu-caused error is resolved; 17 pre-existing/unrelated errors remain (missing icon/id/iconId props, a Button `size` prop bug) — each individually confirmed present in the pre-change baseline capture too. Vitest: 286/292 passed; the 6 failures are pre-existing/unrelated (WASM plugin-load timing, a DnD tree-panel test, studio-path routing, a pack/binary JSON-parse issue, and the demonstrator footer locale-default bug already documented as separate follow-up work in the original Wave 1c plan).

Known out-of-scope follow-up (flagged, not silently left broken): the renderer engine has additional UiLabel-typing fallout beyond this ticket's explicit item list (e.g. ToggleGroupItemProps.text/Button.text call sites elsewhere in that 25k-line file) that the task did not ask me to migrate — every site I actually found broken there was pre-existing-buggy for unrelated reasons (missing required icon/id props), not masking a new UiLabel error, so nothing was silently left half-fixed. No scoped tsconfig/typecheck target was created for the renderer engine package since that's new infrastructure outside this ticket's ask.

Note: mid-session, a concurrent editor briefly clobbered two of my renderer-engine edits (the ui-react import line and the wireLabel function definition) in the shared live file; both were caught via re-verification and restored before final checks.
